faq.question: Q1. How many Project Assistant posts are available at Sri Venkateswara College?
faq.answer: There are 02 Project Assistant (PA) positions in the Department of Physics.

faq.question: Q2. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: DRDO funds the project, "Quantum noise Vs. Classical noise for generation of nondeterministic random number sequence".

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Physics, or a B.Tech in Computer Science, Electronics, Engineering Physics or another related discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: You must be no older than 35 at the time of appointment.

faq.question: Q5. How much does the post pay?
faq.answer: A consolidated fellowship of Rs. 20,000/- per month, for a maximum of 6 months.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary and lasts 06 months.

faq.question: Q7. Will everyone who applies get an interview?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates shortlisted on qualification and desirable experience are called, and they get the interview date by email.

faq.question: Q8. Will I get travel allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Who is the Principal Investigator?
faq.answer: Dr. M. Anil Kumar of the Department of Physics. You can contact him at [email protected] with technical questions about the project.
